questions.q: What distinguishes a requirement from a wish?
options: A measurable criterion and a verification
Having an identifier and an author
questions.explain: “Accelerates to 15 m/s in 3 s” is a requirement; “fast” is not.

questions.q: What should a drone's architecture on one sheet contain?
options: A price list and shop links
The routing of the flight controller's PCB
questions.explain: Without it, it is unclear what has been proven.

questions.q: What do you do after any configuration change?
options: Tests for the change and a log entry
questions.explain: The regression rule and the change log.
Date, what, why, how it was verified.

questions.q: What do accident investigation conclusions have in common?
questions.explain: The absence of a method, not an individual breakage.

questions.q: Which tests are done without props?
options: Hover and flight time at full load
questions.explain: Ground checks — without props; flight metrics — only in the air.

questions.q: What do the arrows on the power diagram show?
questions.explain: The power diagram shows who powers whom and what current flows along each line.
